Price 5 sp; Weight –

About
Catnip, also known as catswort, catmint, and other names, is a flowering species of mint which grows abundantly in jungle and other humid environments.

Catnip ordinarily affects felines as a stimulant, increasing mood, sensitivity and reaction time. Once the stimulant has worn off, the affected feline becomes sluggish and develops temporary immunity to the substance for a period of time. Addiction to catnip is rare, but possible, as some felines may become dependent on the stimulus catnip provides.

Details
Type ingested; Addiction minor, Fortitude DC 10

Effects
Initial Effects For 10 minutes, the user gains a +1 alchemical bonus on initiative checks, Reflex saves, and Acrobatics checks.
Secondary Effects After the initial effects of the catnip expire, the user becomes fatigued for 1d3 hours.
Damage None.

A creature cannot take catnip or a catnip variant while suffering from the secondary effects of catnip or a catnip variant. With proper technique, an alchemist can refine catnip into oils or powders such that it can even grant such benefits to a non-feline (DC 12 Craft (alchemy) or similar check). Such substances are still treated as normal catnip and must be ingested normally, regardless of their refined form. Refining catnip takes about 1 hour for a single refined dose or 30 minutes with appropriate tools (such as an alchemist’s lab).

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
